heading: INT. TASKBRIDGE SYNERGIES - FORTY-FIRST FLOOR BREAK ROOM - LATE AFTERNOON

units.text: INT. TASKBRIDGE SYNERGIES - FORTY-FIRST FLOOR BREAK ROOM - LATE AFTERNOON
A windowless room where the fluorescent light has the colour and mercy of boiled milk.
A single plant, plastic, in a pot nobody waters.
The coffee machine sighs.
PRIYANKA "PRI" SUNDARAM, thirties, in a cardigan pilled by meetings, stands at the sink.
CLIVE HARTWELL-BANKS, fifties, regional vice president, pours the last of the decaf into a mug that reads WORLD'S OKAYEST BOSS.
Pri. Priyanka. Pri-pri. Do you have a minute?
units.name: CLIVE

units.text: I have a thirty-two-minute minute, Clive. It's on the calendar. You invited me to it.
units.name: PRI

units.text: Did I? Brilliant. Then it's synergy.
units.name: CLIVE

units.text: It's a meeting about a meeting.
units.name: PRI

units.text: And the meeting about the meeting is about the meeting about the restructure, which, between you and me, is not really a restructure. It's a re-envisioning.
units.name: CLIVE

units.text: Clive, I've been re-envisioned three times this year. I have a different desk, a different title and a different manager. Last Tuesday I was sent a lanyard that said INTERIM.
units.name: PRI

units.text: And you wear it well.
units.name: CLIVE

units.text: I wear it because the badge reader doesn't recognise the old one.
units.name: PRI

units.text: Okay, Pri, I'm going to be honest with you. I'm hearing frustration.
units.name: CLIVE

units.text: You're hearing me say I'm frustrated.
units.name: PRI

units.text: Which is valid.
units.name: CLIVE

units.text: Which is also not a solution.
units.name: PRI

units.text: Pri, I'm going to say something and I want you to hear it as a gift. The company values you.
units.name: CLIVE

units.text: The company eliminated my team on Friday.
units.name: PRI

units.text: Valued! Past tense is still a tense.
units.name: CLIVE

units.text: Goodbye, Clive.
units.name: PRI

units.text: Same time Thursday?
units.name: CLIVE
